name_en: PM Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY 2.0, Mission Shakti)
benefit: First child: Rs 5000 in two instalments (Rs 3000 + Rs 2000). Second child only if a girl: Rs 6000 in one instalment.
documents_needed: Proof of disadvantaged category (for example BPL card)
Aadhaar-seeded bank or post office account
known_limits: Rules read from a Lok Sabha answer of 20.12.2024. The scheme portal was not checked for newer changes
Source lists Odisha and Telangana as not implementing the scheme (as of 20.12.2024). Not verified as current
Second child benefit depends on the child being a girl, which is unknown during pregnancy. The app can only say 'conditional'
Exact age limit is 18 years 7 months. We only ask years, so age 18 and 55 stay unknown

sources.publisher: Ministry of Women and Child Development, Lok Sabha Unstarred Question 4224

rules.note: 1 = pass only if this child is a girl
